# SCI-FRUIT v0.1 — EL-G0 Population, Access, And Lineage Plan r0.1

Status: **population-construction proposal; no population or custodian is
appointed**

## Present State

No immutable development, qualification, or challenge population exists. No
repository-local observation list is admitted by this record.

Historical population tooling can snapshot a binary, hash generated configs,
and bind observation/APT jobs. It also contains hard-coded prior-study
identities and can stratify using fitted map and kernel outcome metrics. That
tooling is implementation evidence, not an admissible qualification split by
default. The Gate-0 access incident separately quarantines the existing
`validation/fruit_loop*` evidence family and all represented lineage from
untouched qualification.

## Proposed Custody Model

A named human custodian creates the inventory without exposing protected
outcomes to candidate developers. The custodian retains the key translating
opaque unit IDs to raw observation identities and holds qualification/challenge
membership until the authorized access event.

The candidate-neutral inventory contains at least:

```text
opaque_unit_id
lineage_group_id
source_or_target_group_id
acquisition_or_reduction_type
observation_date_bucket
weather_and_scan_geometry_strata_from_input_headers
array_and_network_coverage
raw_input_content_ids
APT_calibration_ephemeris_content_ids
declared_target_or_injection_family
incident_or_prior-study_overlap_state
known_pre-output_applicability_state
```

No candidate/control map value, fitted flux/FWHM, residual, convergence trace,
or prior best iteration enters the split.

## Split Construction

1. Group exact, near-duplicate, repeated-source, repeated-observation,
   injection-parent, nuisance-parent, and descendant products under one lineage
   group.
2. Exclude or quarantine every group with unknown incident/prior-study overlap.
3. Freeze target strata and minimum independent-unit requirements before
   membership is assigned.
4. Assign complete lineage groups by a deterministic keyed procedure held by
   the custodian; do not split descendants across populations.
5. Reveal only development membership at `EL-GD`.
6. Freeze exact qualification/challenge identities and their decision roles at
   `EL-GF`; candidate developers do not receive protected outcomes.
7. Open results only at the exact `EL-GQ` event under the frozen protocol.

The independent unit is not an iteration, array, injected mode, amplitude, or
orientation by default. Observation/source/weather clustering and repeated
modes remain explicit.

## Population Size

No percentage split or sample count is defensible from the repository alone.
The inventory must first report candidate-neutral counts by lineage group and
stratum. A power/precision design then sets minimum independent-unit counts for
protected non-inferiority, prioritized material improvement, tails, failures,
and multiplicity. If the inventory cannot support those counts, the claim
narrows prospectively or the lane returns no-go.

## Incident 001 Binding

`SCI-FRUIT-EL-G0-ACCESS-INCIDENT-001-2026-09-01` is permanent lane lineage.
The complete `validation/fruit_loop*` family and represented inputs,
near-duplicates, sources, injections, nuisances, observations, and descendants
are ineligible for untouched qualification. Unknown overlap fails closed.
